title: Embedded Word Configuration Equality
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a type, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Let $M$ be an $m$-work-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols and states $S$, let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let $q$ be a state. Suppose $v$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $m$ tapes, and the family $\mathrm{wanted}$ of $k$ words agrees with $v$ on the embedded indices. Suppose also that the family $\mathrm{ambient}$ agrees with $\mathrm{wanted}$ outside the image of $\iota$. Then embedding the configuration formed from $q$ and $v$, using the ambient words as tape contents and zero head positions on the other tapes, gives the configuration formed from $q$ and $\mathrm{wanted}$.
hypotheses_covered: A type $S$ and Boolean input word $x$
An $m$-work-tape machine $M$ over Boolean symbols and states $S$
